mods.name: Custom Mob Spawns
mods.description:
Simple configurable mob spawning.
Fork of Custom Spawns that supports 1.20 and beyond.

releases.notes:
### Changes in this version:

- Removed support for 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.3, 1.20.4, 1.20.5, and 1.20.6 due to changes in Fabric's "Identifier".
- Added 1.21 support (newer versions should work).

### Behind the scenes:

- Updated Cloth Config minimum version from **11.0.99** to **15.0.127** (Aka the earliest version for 1.21)
- Updated Mod Menu minimum version from **7.0.0** to **11.0.0-beta.1** (Aka the earliest version for 1.21)
- Updated Fabric API minimum version from **0.68.1** to **0.100.1** (Aka the earliest version for 1.21)
- Updated default game version of the mod from **1.20** to **1.21**
